name: GDrive Backup
description: Save & load your data to Google Drive!

slot-count.name: Save slots count
slot-count.description: Choose how many save slots are available. <cr>Note:</c> This setting is purely <cg>visual</c>, changing this value does <cy>not</c> delete your save files.

button-position.name: Button position
button-position.description: Sets the <cy>position</c> of the mod's button on the <cg>account menu</c>.

bottom-button.name: Main menu shortcut button
bottom-button.description: <cg>adds</cg> a button for GDrive Backup to the bottom of the main menu (next to the geode button).

new-icon.name: Use new Drive icon
new-icon.description: Use the new weird gradient-y google drive icon for the buttons instead of the 'lame' 'old' 'one'

advanced-title.name: Backup Settings
advanced-title.description: Manage which data to include in saves, and what to load from those saves! <cy>these options are local to this device, and aren't synced between devices.</c>

platformer-data.name: Platformer saves
platformer-data.description: Platformer save data  <cc>(aka CCPlatformerSave.dat)</c> includes all your saved platformer levels checkpoints

game-options.name: Game & editor options
game-options.description: Load game & editor options (such as quick keys, CBS, button rows, link controls, etc.)  <cc>Note that this doesn't load every single option, and mainly excludes graphics options.</c>

keybind-data.name: Custom keybinds
keybind-data.description: Includes your custom keybinds.  <cc>This doesn't doesn't every single option, and mainly excludes graphics options.</c>

llm-data.name: Level data
llm-data.description: Level data  <cc>(aka CCLocalLevels.dat)</c> includes your created & saved levels and lists.

gm-data.name: Game data
gm-data.description: Game Data  <cc>(aka CCGameManager.dat)</c> includes data such as your stats, achievements, icons, options, keybinds, etc.
